cards.q: What does BPDU Guard do and what happens when it triggers?
cards.a: BPDU Guard protects a PortFast/edge port: when a BPDU is received on that port, it error-disables (err-disables) the port and logs a message. The port is moved out of service until manual intervention or a configured recover mechanism.

cards.q: What is the key difference between BPDU Guard and PortFast?
cards.a: PortFast is the edge-port behavior that skips listening/learning. BPDU Guard is the protection that err-disables the port if an unexpected BPDU is received.

cards.q: What problem does an edge port with PortFast but without BPDU Guard leave?
cards.a: An edge port immediately forwards; if accidentally connected to another switch announcing BPDUs, it can create a loop that BPDU Guard could have detected/blocked.

cards.q: What command enables BPDU Guard on an interface and globally?
cards.a: spanning-tree bpduguard enable per interface; spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default globally (applies to ports where PortFast is configured).

cards.q: How do you verify a port is in err-disabled BPDU Guard state, and how do you recover it?
cards.a: show interfaces status and show spanning-tree show errdisabled/state; recovery by manually shutting/no-shut or with errdisable recovery cause bpduguard interval <seconds>.

cards.q: What is errdisable recovery and why configure it?
cards.a: errdisable recovery cause bpduguard automatically restores the port after a timer, avoiding manual intervention. It is a recovery mechanism, not a replacement for fixing the underlying cause.

cards.q: How does BPDU Guard differ from BPDU Filter?
cards.a: BPDU Guard err-disables the port when a BPDU is received. BPDU Filter suppresses/filters BPDUs and can make STP not participate, hiding loops; it is riskier and not a 'safer' version of Guard.

cards.q: When BPDU Guard and Loop Guard are both configured, which takes precedence?
cards.a: BPDU Guard takes priority. It err-disables an edge port where a BPDU is received, regardless of Loop Guard being enabled.

cards.q: How does BPDU Guard relate to Root Guard, and can they be configured on the same port?
cards.a: BPDU Guard protects edge ports. Root Guard protects root placement on segments facing other switches. They address different problems and generally apply to different types of ports; both can use the spanning-tree guard <keyword> form but the configuration context differs.

cards.q: What happens to BPDU Guard on a non-PortFast port?
cards.a: BPDU Guard is primarily for PortFast/edge ports. On a normal (non-edge) port, STP does not expect a BPDU to be unexpected in the same way; the feature is intended for edge ports.

cards.q: Why is BPDU Guard the first defense for edge ports in practice?
cards.a: Because end-user ports are the most likely to be misconnected or to have rogue devices, and BPDU Guard ensures an accidental BPDU does not create a loop.

cards.q: What exactly gets enabled with 'spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default'?
cards.a: It enables BPDU Guard default on all ports where PortFast is enabled, providing edge-port protection network-wide.

cards.q: What is the mental model for BPDU Guard?
cards.a: If this edge port receives a BPDU, shut it down (err-disable) — protect the rest of the network from a rogue BPDU.

cards.q: How do you find which ports are in bpduguard errdisable and reset them?
cards.a: show errdisable detect and show interfaces status / show interfaces Gi0/1, then shutdown/no shutdown; consider errdisable recovery cause bpduguard.

cards.q: Why should errdisable recovery be used carefully?
cards.a: It can mask a persistent problem by bringing the port back repeatedly; the underlying cause (e.g., a device sending BPDUs) should be fixed first.

cards.q: Does BPDU Guard prevent packets from being forwarded after triggering?
cards.a: The port becomes err-disabled (administratively down from an STP perspective), so it does not forward user data until recovered.

cards.q: What are the key BPDU Guard facts in quick review?
cards.a: Protects PortFast/edge ports; err-disables port on unexpected BPDU; enable: spanning-tree bpduguard enable / global spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default; recovery: manual or errdisable recovery cause bpduguard; priority over Loop Guard; distinct from BPDU Filter and Root Guard.
